text_block_list.name: Arcade Attendant
text_block_list.text:
We are now accepting participants for the 
"Umuscle Fighter 3" tournament!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, isn't this the exact game I was 
just sweating in on stream the other 
day?!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A tournament, huh... Maybe I'll enter♪

text_block_list.name: Arcade Attendant
text_block_list.text:
"A fierce offensive from Loves! Going from 
a standing mid to a low! She's mixing it 
up!"

text_block_list.name: Arcade Attendant
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! The Umamuscle Gauge has maxed out 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Arcade Attendant
text_block_list.text:
"It connects—!! A 60% combo after 
cornering them at the edge of the 
screen—!"

text_block_list.name: Arcade Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your victory! What 
would you say was the deciding factor?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's obviously love! Not just for your 
own character, but for your opponent's 
character too ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because I truly love my opponent, I've 
got that girl's habits and frame 
advantages—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...That's it! That might just be it!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew! Wasn't that a pretty good match?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It felt like they saw through every 
single move we made...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I just read your moves♪ Chrono-chan, 
you kinda remind me of the karate master 
from UmaFi 3!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Loves Only You's running 
became more refined and gained even more 
sharpness.
